notes:
Summary:
- Enterprise RAG/search platform for legal + financial docs. Heavy emphasis on accuracy (rerank using cross-encoder for top-k) and strict audit/residency.
Scale & performance:
- Target index size: 800M vectors (range 300M - 1B). Avg vector dim ~1536 (multi-model embeddings).
- Query profile: 120-200 qps (peak), typical query returns top-50 then rerank top-10 with cross-encoder. SLA target: p95 end-to-end <= 150ms, p99 <= 350ms for single-shot retrieval+rerank.
- Cost target: aim to beat current stack (elastic+homegrown) — target <= $0.001 per query end-to-end, appetite to trade some cost for latency improvements.
Technical preferences & must-haves:
- Prefer dedicated or private deployment (VPC) for custody + compliance; on-prem for EU sensitive tenants.
- Need SSO/SAML, KMS integration (bring-your-own-key), audit logs with 12+ months retention, ISO27001 evidence.
- Require support for mixed-precision quantized vectors (8-bit/4-bit) and ability to do sharded ANN with exact reranking step.
POC notes & results:
- POC ran against 50M subset: Redwood Optimize suggestions (batching + large KV cache) reduced per-query GPU token cost by ~35% vs baseline.
- Retrieval latency: median ~45ms, p95 ~120ms on Dedicated H100 pool (batching=auto, cache enabled). Rerank step cost the bulk; exploring hybrid: ANN recall@100 tuned to 0.98, cross-encoder rerank on top-10.
- Bottlenecks identified: vector storage IO during large coalesced scans, re-ranking CPU/GPU handoff, and warm cache fill for cold-start queries.
Commercial / Org notes:
- Decision makers: CTO (Marina Kowalski), Head of Search (Evan Patel), Legal (Susan Kline). Procurement timeline aggressive if SLA and DPA acceptable.
- Quote from CTO: "Latency is non-negotiable for interactive legal review — p95 must stay <150ms or we lose adoption."
Next steps & asks from Fractal:
- Provide a scaled POC plan (ingest 500M sample, show linearized cost model); commit to a target p95/p99 SLA for Dedicated + fallback policy.
- Draft DPA + provide ISO artifact; granular pricing (unit cost at scale) and options for commit discounts.
- Demo of rerank offload pattern (GPU vs CPU tradeoffs) and configurable caching/TTL policies.
Open questions / blockers:
- Legal DPA signoff timeline unknown.
- Capacity reservation: need clear SLA and plan for burst beyond reserved pool.
- Confirm support matrix for model variants (dense dims 768 vs 1536) and multi-model routing for cost control.
